test_protocol: All nine models frozen before new reserved-test evaluation; test galaxies appeared in historical validation during development.
bootstrap: 1000 galaxy-grouped draws, seed 0; repeated visits are retained.
calibration: Coverage diagnostics only; no calibration fitted on reserved test data.
response_method: v2 Gaussian LSF injection with original errors held fixed; not a repeat of two-dimensional morphological dispersion.

unsupported_emission.note: Correlated/blended truth-centered windows; not a blind-search false-positive rate.

redshift_uncertainty.note: Reports midpoint and uniform-within-bin central coverage; randomized PIT ignores truth positions within bins.
